message.content: In a conversation with LiHua, ThaneChambers expresses enthusiasm for stealth mechanics, indicating that they believe these elements can significantly enrich gameplay. Specifically, ThaneChambers mentions a desire for stealth boosts, stating, "I’d love to see some stealth boosts! Being able to sneak past enemies or get the jump on them adds a whole new layer to gameplay. It could lead to some epic moments with strategies and surprises." This shows that ThaneChambers sees stealth boosts as a valuable addition to the game, enhancing the player's ability to navigate and interact with the environment in innovative ways, thereby creating memorable and strategic gameplay experiences.
